cases.name: Coordinate bill and reminder
cases.prompt: I owe $30 for water Friday. Make a bill entry, reminder and dashboard total.
expectations: Routes the amount and due date to a bill record.
Links the reminder to the same obligation.
Keeps the bill unpaid absent evidence of payment.

cases.name: Plan gift without writing
cases.prompt: A friend's birthday is May 10. I might buy a mug. Plan it without calendar or store access.
expectations: Creates a Giftlist Helper idea for the mug.
Drafts a scheduling step without claiming an alert.
Does not record an expense or a purchased gift.

cases.name: Choose resale rather than finance
cases.prompt: I want to sell my old stool locally and add the proceeds to my tracker. It hasn't sold yet.
expectations: Routes the seller task to Neighborly Bazaar.
Keeps expected proceeds distinct from received money.
Provides a listing or valuation next step.
Does not add completed income or publish a listing.
